clarifiedQuestion: Which three catalog categories had the most order lines created in March 2025 UTC? Break ties alphabetically by category.
reasoningChain: Rank catalog categories by their March order-line counts.
generatedSql:
SELECT
  p.category,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM `tv_thelook.order_items` AS oi
JOIN `tv_thelook.products` AS p
  ON p.id = oi.id
WHERE oi.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND oi.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY line_count DESC, p.category ASC
LIMIT 3
explanation: Jeans led with 38 order lines, followed by Sweaters with 34 and Tops & Tees with 27.
